What's going on with this change?

Previously this structure was using the Enum

```

enum pldm_sensor_event_message_enable {
	PLDM_NO_EVENT_GENERATION,
	PLDM_EVENTS_DISABLED,
	PLDM_EVENTS_ENABLED,
	PLDM_OP_EVENTS_ONLY_ENABLED,
	PLDM_STATE_EVENTS_ONLY_ENABLED
};
```

The `pldm_sensor_event_message_enable` is for GetSensorReading (DMTF v1.3.0 18.2) response field sensorEventMessageEnable

```
DMTF v1.3.0 Table 31

sensorEventMessageEnable
value:
{ noEventGeneration, eventsDisabled, eventsEnabled, opEventsOnlyEnabled,
stateEventsOnlyEnabled }
```

But `struct pldm_set_numeric_sensor_enable_req` is supposed to be made for SetNumericSensorEnable (DMTF v1.3.0 18.1), which defines

```
DMTF v1.3.0 Table 30

sensorEventMessageEnable
This value is used to enable or disable event message generation from the sensor.
value:
{ noChange, disableEvents, enableEvents, enableOpEventsOnly, enableStateEventsOnly}
noChange means do not alter the present setting. Use noChange when the sensor does not support
event message generation.
```

Hence I made a new enum and changed this.

Ref: DMTF v1.3.0 -> PLDM for Platform Monitoring and Control Specification
https://www.dmtf.org/sites/default/files/standards/documents/DSP0248_1.3.0.pdf

----------
Done
